heading: Tonight
text: Localized evening showers west and north diminishing. Mainly clear in southern valleys, and periods of clouds west and north. Additional scattered showers in NY and the St. Lawrence Valley. Lows 50 to 55, some upper 40s north. Winds south to southwest near 10 mph, diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Tuesday
text: Periods of sun in southern valleys. Morning clouds and a few showers north, then breaks of sun, with localized, passing showers, more numerous over the higher terrain. Cool. Highs in the 60s to near 70 north, low to mid 70s in the Champlain Valley and south. Light winds becoming southwest less than 10 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Localized evening showers west and north tapering off. Partly cloudy in southern valleys, and some partial clearing north. Lows in the 50s, some upper 40s north. Winds becoming light and variable.
